card.line: The Great Sea is the Mediterranean Sea, which marked the western edge of the land God promised to Israel.

moments.title: The western border
moments.text: Moses tells Israel that the coastline of the Great Sea will be their western boundary. The northern border also begins at the Great Sea and runs to Mount Hor.

moments.title: Land to the Great Sea
moments.text: God tells Joshua that Israel's territory will reach west as far as the Great Sea. He promises to be with Joshua and never leave him.

moments.title: Kings along the coast
moments.text: When the kings west of the Jordan hear the news, including those all along the coast of the Great Sea, they come together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.

moments.title: Judah's western border
moments.text: The western border of the clans of Judah is the coastline of the Great Sea.

moments.title: Boundaries in Ezekiel's vision
moments.text: The Lord GOD gives the boundaries of the land. The Great Sea marks the western edge, and the northern and southern borders both reach to it.
